### Key differences

- **Storage:** Harbor offers 12 more units (36 vs. 24), i.e., 50 % more capacity than Cedar *(W1, W2)*.
- **Cost efficiency:** Cedar works out to 5 credits per stored unit (120 ÷ 24), while Harbor works out to 5 credits per unit as well (180 ÷ 36) *(W1, W2)*.
- **Export format:** Cedar exports to **CSV** *(W1)*; Harbor exports to **JSON** *(W2)*. These are structurally different—CSV is a flat, tabular interchange format, while JSON is a nested, key-value format suited to structured or hierarchical data.
